verdict.rationale: Recurring or background automation is a fair axis for a financial infrastructure platform. The only relevant evidence is a single marketing line about "flows to automate lending and repayments," which suggests some built-in automated processing but gives no detail on how users configure it or how general it is. missing for 10: documentation of user-configurable automations (scheduled or recurring payments, rule-based triggers), any general-purpose automation builder beyond lending repayments, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
